<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, touching **48** documentable anchor(s).

**29** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `packageId (4 routes)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `de5b3784698c45ed4d007ecd96058f1cab544740` — the merge of head `b50e93b45477292c07f9f6df12749cfe2aeae615` into base `8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin de5b3784698c45ed4d007ecd96058f1cab544740 && git checkout de5b3784698c45ed4d007ecd96058f1cab544740
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af b50e93b45477292c07f9f6df12749cfe2aeae615 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af && git merge --no-ff b50e93b45477292c07f9f6df12749cfe2aeae615

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8c8c5b5255109a7d039225e48e8f6b718247a9af` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

ACCEPT · PR #28393 · Head-sha `b50e93b45477292c07f9f6df12749cfe2aeae615` · 2026-10-31T11:01Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 元数据的保存、发布、回滚、删除四个入口，遇到 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `NOT_CREATABLE` / `INVALID_METADATA` / `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` 拒绝时，会在 `sys_metadata_audit` 里写一条 `denied` 记录（码用表里已文档化的小写值）。
- **为什么改：** 审计表文档一直写着这四个拒绝码，但从没有代码写过，读 `/audit` 的人会以为被拒的尝试从未发生。
- **风险与回滚：** 调用方拿到的错误（码、状态、文案）不变；审计写入尽力而为；四个入口的公开签名不变，内部拆成公开包装加私有主体。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-refusal-audit.ts`（封闭映射表与去重标记）；`protocol.ts` 四个入口的包装段。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.refusal-audit-rows.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：在入口出口统一记账，覆盖以后新加的拒绝点；映射表封闭、不铸新值，`item_locked` 与 `metadata_conflict` 不重记；可合。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 12 files, +706/-119. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28393`: NOT governed, 825 lines ≤ 3000, Tier S. `Clause-②: no` holds: no `packages/spec/src/**` path; the four door signatures are unchanged (the request shapes are local, unexported aliases of the old inline types); the audit column's value set is unchanged (each written value is one it already documents). `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.
- **Premise measured:** the dev found every code the card lists refused by a real door, so nothing is removed from the vocabulary; `item_locked` was already stamped by the lock gates on all four doors. Seat read the diff: `withRefusalAudit` wraps each door's private body, writes a row only for a code in the closed map with a non-empty type and name, marks the error so a refusal passing two doors is recorded once, and rethrows the same error. Rows carry `organizationId: null`, as the ledger's type requires and every existing denied row does.
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 48 runs: 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. The seat's REWORK (private `...Unaudited` bodies; the `adr0112-ok: D6b` marks on the lower-case values) is in `bfad1b20b`. The Test Core red at that head was five objectql pins asserting "no insert" on a refused save; `b50e93b45` makes each assert that the only insert is the refusal's `sys_metadata_audit` row, so "no metadata row is written" is still pinned.
- **Accepted deviations:** the file surface grew by test-only edits in `packages/objectql/src/**` and `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, each forced by a gate; `sys-metadata-audit.object.ts` is untouched because nothing is removed.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** whether the repository's own read-only-base refusal (`ITEM_LOCKED`, `lockSource: 'package'`) is ever reached past the lock gate without a row is unmeasured, and recorded in the PR's acceptance notes. `Skills-docs: none`.
- **Landing clause:** Tier S ordinary queue landing. The seat flips ready and enables auto-merge through the relay, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28355.
